description: Fetch Canadian census values (Statistics Canada) for chosen regions and census vectors, aggregated at a geographic level (province, CMA, census division, subdivision, tract, dissemination area). Returns one row per geography with a column per vector plus population, dwellings and area. Source: Statistics Canada Census; quota 500 region ids/day.

geo_hierarchy.description: Include the parent geography hierarchy columns in each row (default false)

level.description: Geographic aggregation level of the returned rows: Regions (the listed regions themselves), PR, CMA, CD, CSD, CT, DA or DB

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-1000, default 200)

regions.description: Census regions to query, keyed by level with arrays of region ids (e.g. {"CMA":["35535"]} for Toronto, {"PR":["35"]} for Ontario)

vectors.description: Census vector ids to return (e.g. ["v_CA21_1","v_CA21_6"] = population 2021, 2016)

name: censusmapper.census.get_data

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: CensusMapper Census Data
